title: Record quality Work Item close-order process issue
rawUserRequest: If a process problem is discovered, record it in the execution plan, correct the process before the next Work Item, and continue the complete PR/merge/close/branch-cleanup lifecycle.

declaredIntent.summary: Record the observed Work Item close-order process issue before the next governed Work Item.

Deleting or rewriting historical Work Item evidence.

sources.reason: Required lifecycle order: ai-close-work-item must run before branch deletion.
Execution plan and existing process-issue ledger.
Evidence of the merged quality Work Item and its closure attempt.

riskAssessment.reason: Record a fail-closed process issue without changing historical evidence.

executionDecision.reason: User authorized continuous execution and the repository rule already defines the corrective order.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm issue is recorded, historical evidence is retained, and no branch-delete automation is added.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The final Contract and Summary identify the observed close-order failure and its governing evidence.
The execution plan records that PR #387 was merged with branch deletion requested before ai-close-work-item, which caused the first close attempt to fail closed.
The plan explicitly requires merge without provider-side branch deletion, followed by ai-close-work-item as the sole lifecycle closer.
No historical Contract, Summary, Archive Manifest, or PR evidence is removed.
guidelines: Preserve historical Work Item evidence and record process issues in the execution plan.
Do not weaken or bypass the repository lifecycle checks.

intent.problem: The quality Work Item PR merged successfully, but the merge command requested provider-side branch deletion before make ai-close-work-item. The close command correctly failed closed because the branch was no longer identifiable.
constraints: Record the issue before continuing the next Work Item.
Keep the existing AGENTS.md lifecycle rule as the governing process.
Do not delete historical evidence or alter the merged implementation.
intent.rationale: Make the observed execution issue auditable and make the next PR lifecycle follow the repository's canonical closure order.

evidence: The plan contains the corrective quality Work Item record and the close-order issue entry.
